faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need a YouTube API key?
faq.a1: No! Our tool works without any API keys. Simply paste the channel URL and get instant results.
faq.q2: What channel data can I extract?
faq.a2: You can extract subscriber count, total videos, total views, channel name, description, channel ID, custom URL, country, and join date.
faq.q3: Is this tool free to use?
faq.a3: Yes, completely free! Extract data from unlimited channels without any restrictions or hidden fees.
faq.q4: Can I use this for competitor analysis?
faq.a4: Absolutely! This tool is perfect for analyzing competitor channels, understanding their growth metrics, and identifying successful strategies in your niche.
faq.q5: Is there a limit on how many channels I can analyze?
faq.a5: No limits! Extract data from as many YouTube channels as you need, completely free. Perfect for comprehensive market research and competitive analysis.
